quote: You built walls to keep out the pain, but you only locked yourself inside the dark. Every heavy secret you carry weighs down your exhausted shoulders. You hide your quiet tears behind a forced, tired smile every single day. Nobody ever notices the quiet storms raging right beneath your calm surface. Someday you will finally learn how to drop the armor and just breathe.
